description: A non-ARQ U_PDU asking for 2 retransmissions goes out three times, as three copies of one type 7 D_PDU in one transmission.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ. The U_PDU "hello" (priority 0, TTL 0) has DELIVERY MODE non-ARQ (tx mode 2) with Minimum Number of Retransmissions 2, so the subnetwork sends it 3 times (A-0080, A-0081, A-0083); the D_PDU stays queued until it has been sent that often (C-0848). All three copies fit one transmission, so they all go in it (C-0884, C-1051): the same 36-byte D_PDU, C_PDU ID 0, offset 0, three times, with only EOT and the reception window stamped per copy (C-0352). The 108 bytes fit one 256-byte block, so every copy starts at the block start and carries EOT 10 and reception window 10 (duration 5550 ms; C-0104, C-1043): the window ends with this transmission because no copy is left for a later one (C-0350, C-1051). With one D_PDU there is no spreading to do (C-0885, C-1054).
